name: Mandate Termination Requested
description:
Intermediate lifecycle Message requesting permanent mandate termination.

It does not directly modify mandate state. Only the inherited
applyMandateTermination workflow may transition the mandate to Mandate/Status Terminated,
emit Mandate/Mandate Terminated, and gracefully terminate mandate
processing.

The inherited Message correlation fields may be used. No lifecycle timestamp
is supplied by this Message.

reason.description: Optional human-readable or machine-generated termination reason.
